name: od-wordpress-monitor
description: Local development tooling for the OD WordPress Monitor monorepo.

scripts.env:start: wp-env start && wp-env run cli wp plugin activate agent monitor
scripts.env:test:start: wp-env start --config=.wp-env.test.json --auto-port && wp-env run cli --config=.wp-env.test.json wp plugin activate agent monitor
scripts.test:php: wp-env run cli --config=.wp-env.test.json --env-cwd=wp-content/od-wordpress-monitor-workspace env WP_TESTS_DIR=/wordpress-phpunit composer test
scripts.env:test:wp68:start: wp-env start --config=.wp-env.wp68.json --auto-port && wp-env run cli --config=.wp-env.wp68.json wp plugin activate agent monitor
scripts.test:php:wp68: wp-env run cli --config=.wp-env.wp68.json --env-cwd=wp-content/od-wordpress-monitor-workspace env WP_TESTS_DIR=/wordpress-phpunit composer test
